What's new in Vekrun 0.6.4 — Vultr servers, a chosen mobile target, and Organizations (preview)

• Work Anywhere: rent a Vultr server alongside Hetzner and DigitalOcean. Each plan shows how strongly it can isolate AI work (hardware, hardware if available, or sandboxed) and its price in the provider's own currency.
• Mobile: pick which simulator or emulator the Factory builds and tests on, from Home.
• Organizations (preview, Settings → Organizations): create an organization with a recovery code, join one with a join code and an invite, and manage members and admins. Evidence receipts signed by members are trusted automatically and show who signed them.
• Fixed: Hetzner prices shown as USD instead of EUR.
